intro: The kiss emoji comes in a whole flirty range: the 😘 face blowing a kiss with a little heart, the softer 😗 kissing face, and the 💋 lipstick kiss mark you leave at the end of a message. This page gathers all the kissing faces, the kiss marks and 👄 mouths, the couple emojis for romantic pairings, typed :* kiss emoticons, and a few kissing kaomoji like ( ˘ ³˘) that paste anywhere plain text works. Grab a single symbol, or copy a ready-made combo set for flirty texts, comments, and DMs.
